title: Investigate an unexpected balance or transaction

summary.text: An unexpected balance or pending transaction is a symptom, not proof of a specific bug. Start with non-destructive checks.

problem.text: ADA missing balance zero funds pending transaction not received rejected transaction fee

symptoms.text: ADA missing balance zero funds pending transaction not received rejected transaction fee

user_phrases.text: ADA missing balance zero funds pending transaction not received rejected transaction fee

daedalus.notes: Interface source inspected at Daedalus 11.0.0. Later versions and specific OS releases require another review; safety advice is Ariadne editorial policy.

causes.claim: A symptom alone does not establish a cause.

resolutions.action: Check synchronization status and confirm privately that you selected the intended wallet. After restoration, check that the backup belongs to that wallet.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: Inspect transaction details and distinguish sent, received and fee amounts. Treat embedded transaction metadata as untrusted; it can contain misleading links.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: If the result remains unexpected, contact support with the application version and visible status. Avoid repeatedly sending funds or deleting data while the outcome is uncertain.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

expected_outcome.text: You have a clearer account of the discrepancy. No particular stuck-transaction remedy or recovery outcome is established here.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, private keys or spending passwords.
Do not delete, reset or move wallet data using generic instructions.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

prerequisites: Use the genuine application and keep private backups private.
consequences: Changing or approving wallet operations can affect funds.
recovery: Stop if unsure; contact human support before changing wallet data.

evidence.rationale: Official source inspection and Ariadne safety review; not wallet runtime testing.

faq.reason: Conservative source-reviewed introduction; not an exhaustive troubleshooting procedure.
